title: Unchanging Plan
story:
A young architect once designed a beautiful building.

He worked on the plan for months.

When he showed it to others, some suggested changes.

Some said it should be taller.

Some said it should be shorter.

Some said it should be moved.

He listened carefully.

But he said,

“This plan is already carefully designed.”

“If we keep changing it, the structure will not be strong.”

So he stayed with the original design.

Years later, the building stood strong and beautiful.

People admired it.

In life, many voices try to change our direction.

Opinions shift.

Advice changes.

Circumstances push us in different ways.

But God’s plan never fails.

His purpose is already established.

And it lasts forever.
life_lesson:
God’s plans are eternal and perfect.

Trust His purpose even when you don’t understand it.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You that Your plans never fail.

Help me to trust Your purpose for my life.

When I am confused, remind me that You are in control.

Teach me to rest in Your perfect will.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
Do you struggle when your plans don’t work out?

Can you trust that God’s plan is better than yours?

What situation do you need to surrender to His purpose today?
verse:
But the plans of the Lord stand firm forever,
the purposes of His heart through all generations.
